audience: sales and operations teams that keep contacts, companies, deals and tickets in HubSpot

useCases.title: Find deals by pipeline stage
useCases.text: Search deals with property filters, and list the deal pipelines to read the stage names.

useCases.title: Find contacts with missing data
useCases.text: List the property definitions to find internal names, then search contacts with filters on those properties.

useCases.title: See which companies link to contacts
useCases.text: Read the associations of up to 100 contacts at once, then read the company records by id.

useCases.title: Update a lifecycle or deal stage
useCases.text: Read the record, then update the given property values. Properties you do not list keep their values.

useCases.title: Create a record from a new lead
useCases.text: List the owners to find an owner id, then create a contact, company, deal or ticket with the property values.
